**Agricultural residue burning.** Small agricultural fires in the Mekong are systematically under-resolved by MODIS relative to VIIRS. The sub-pixel multiplier for agricultural small fires in the Mekong is 3.65, meaning VIIRS detects roughly that many more small-fire pixels per MODIS detection in this regime. This is the dominant source of the constellation step-jump illusion in the region: raw counts rise not because more fire exists, but because VIIRS resolves sub-pixel agricultural burns that MODIS misses.
